headline: Peria Karamalai Tea submits annual general meeting minutes
hook: AGM minutes filed for Peria Karamalai Tea
summary: The Peria Karamalai Tea & Produce Company Limited has submitted the official minutes of its Annual General Meeting held on September 26, 2026, to the exchange. This routine filing documents the formal proceedings and shareholder resolutions passed during the meeting. Such procedural disclosures are standard regulatory requirements for listed entities. Retail investors can access the documentation for corporate governance transparency.
why_it_matters: Routine governance update with no direct impact on stock price.
